verdict.rationale: Merchants control which agents can reach their catalog and checkout. Onboarding is per agent: the seller picks the agent to sell through and sends it an approval request. In embedded mode, only a seller can initiate the required Orchestrated Commerce Agreement (OCA), which authorizes data access, and either party can terminate it at any time; this gives allow and deny (revocation) control per agent. Missing for 10: any rate-limiting or throttling of agent traffic to catalog/checkout, granular per-platform access policies beyond per-agent agreements, GA availability (the OCA flow is documented as private preview), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
